bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  Step into a world of refined elegance at The Grand Hotel Birmingham. Nestled in the heart of the city, this iconic establishment offers a truly unforgettable Afternoon Tea experience.  Afternoon Tea is served in Madeleine bar, where sophistication meets indulgence. Hand crafted cocktails and delectable bites are served within the vibrant and glamorous atmosphere.  Sip on a selection of finest teas brewed to perfection. Delight your taste buds with an array of sandwiches and freshly baked pastries. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply craving a moment of luxury, this Afternoon Tea promises to be an enchanting journey of flavours and impeccable service. The menu, created by Head Pastry Chef Roger Lomas, takes quintessentially British flavours and delivers them through classic French patisserie techniques. A grand twist of elegance and French flair into a delightful petit gateaux.  The Grand Hotel Birmingham is located right by Birmingham Cathedral in the city centre, just a short distance from Snow Hill and Grand Central Station.
